item.title: No free ride for India's rise as Trump official says US won't let India become rival like China
item.description: US Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau says that Washington, in its dealings with India, will avoid repeating the "mistakes" it made with China 20 years ago.

item.title: US House rejects bid to curb Trump's Iran war powers
item.description: The US House of Representatives rejected a bipartisan effort to curb Donald Trump's authority to wage war against Iran, despite fierce criticism over the lack of congressional approval.

item.title: US and Venezuela agree to re-establish diplomatic ties
item.description: The United States and Venezuela's interim authorities agreed to re-establish diplomatic and consular relations, marking a significant shift since Maduro's capture.

item.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts 3 ballistic missiles targeting Prince Sultan Air Base
item.description: Saudi Arabia intercepts three ballistic missiles targeting the Prince Sultan Air Base, marking a significant escalation in the regional conflict between the US-Israeli alliance and Iran.

item.title: US investigation points to likely American role in Iran school bombing — report
item.description: Evidence suggests US strike on IRGC naval base in Minab hit adjacent elementary school on 28 February, killing at least 175, most of them children.

item.title: Trump says currently not considering US ground troop deployment in Iran war
item.description: The US president says sending troops into Iran would waste time while commenting on the country’s losses during the conflict.

item.title: Daily News Brief | 6 March
item.description: Israel says 'broad‑scale' strikes on Iranian infrastructure have begun. And Türkiye's Erdogan warns Middle East tensions at 'terrifying' level... listen for more

item.title: Israel launches fresh air strikes on Beirut's southern suburbs, orders evacuations
item.description: The Israeli army has mounted a series of air strikes across Lebanon since Monday, killing more than 120 people and injuring nearly 700 others.

item.title: Spain says appealing to Trump 'completely useless' as frustration in EU grows
item.description: 'There is a growing sense at the EU level that it's completely useless to continue appealing to Donald Trump's vanity or personal interests,' Spanish Culture Minister Ernest Urtasun says.

item.title: Tokyo urges Iran to release two detained Japanese nationals
item.description: Japanese officials say embassy staff remain in contact with two detained citizens in Iran while urging authorities to release them.
